preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have compromised the owner's private key
Contract must have accumulated some token balance from fees to exploit

exploit_hint: As owner, call setMarketinWalleAddress() to set the marketing wallet to attacker's address, then trigger swapAndLiquify by transferring tokens to accumulate fees. The contract will send accumulated BNB to the attacker-controlled marketing wallet. Alternatively, use changeRouterVeslon() to mint massive tokens to attacker address if the ________ address is compromised.
